collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — BEYOND THE HORIZON, EVENTS 081 to 130 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more speculative branching events continuing "Isola — Beyond the Horizon" (001-080), in the same format: EVENT nnn — TITLE, SETUP, choices A/B/C, two mutually exclusive outcomes per choice, and an optional "Content note:".

ledger.why: the owner (2026-11-15): the person the event is about is a cast villager shown by name, the role word kept as flavor (the villager need not have that job)

collection.description: A scholar wonders whether there might be many peoples beyond the sea, each with its own language.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (Name1), a scholar, wonders whether there might be many peoples beyond the sea, each with its own language.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: Children invent nonsense languages and spend the afternoon "translating."

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: A teacher wonders how people who spoke different languages would ever understand each other.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: A scholar wonders whether distant peoples might share a common tongue for trade.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: An elder worries that a shared tongue might make smaller languages fade.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: Villagers realize that even on Isola, different villages use different words for the same fish.

c2__fx.name: Outcome C2
c2__fx.text: A villager who signs rather than speaks points out that languages need not be spoken at all; everyone learns a new sign that evening.

c2__text.name: Outcome C2
c2__text.text: A villager who signs rather than speaks points out that languages need not be spoken at all; everyone learns a new sign that evening.
